title: UART Transmit
text: Send serial data to the Universal Asynchronous Receiver Transmitter (UART) port, 1 input; {UART module}, {Additional package header} sets the prefix header, {Additional package terminator} sets the suffix terminator E and {Enable blocking mode}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Enable blocking mode
params.values: Enable blocking mode for data transmission off (default) | on
